text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you put on fake nails
when your
real ones are in this
condition...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's toenail is split right down
to the
cuticle and discolored a reddish
black.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I can run! I can!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please don't take this injury lightly just
because
it's your toenail.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Every time you race, your legs are
strained far
beyond anything humans
experience.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how much shock you
absorb with
the balls of your feet, the
stress on your toes and
nails is also
tremendous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But can't I just tape them?!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
What if you push yourself too hard and
it gets
infected? Or you injure another
part of your body
trying to protect your
toes as you run?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't the pain almost too much to bear
this
time?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
One unwise choice is all it takes to
completely
throw away your future as a
racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We fill her prescription just to be safe
and leave
the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! I don't care what
happens
after that! I'm gonna be in the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I'll quit! If I can't run there,
then I
might as well just give up for
good!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on! This is literally a

once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! I'm not
gonna
give it up just because of my
stupid toenail!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
What? Your toenail split again? ...Well, I
guess
you're going to miss the next
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I'm sure you can catch up to
the
others if you work extra hard after.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, her toenail split again. This time it
was
because she practiced too much.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if there's anything you want to talk
about,
just... know that you can confide
in me.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Jordan's toenail split again.
Yep... it's
hard to recommend her for
tryouts at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Oof, yeah... The injury was self-reported
too,
right? People talk, and, well, it's
hard to know if
the injury's real or not...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Sigh. I wish she would just tell me if she doesn't feel like running, then I could figure something out with her...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I... I don't want to miss another race!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've never been any good at studying! I
can't do
anything right! My teachers
always yell at me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But finally, for once in my life, I was
winning! I
thought I could actually be
someone! And now...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My toenail's taken everything from me!
Even the
Classics...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My dreams will never come true! If this
keeps up,
I'll...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Agh, I've had it! I'm so sick of this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears well up in her eyes as her
frustration builds.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I can! It doesn't hurt that bad, honest!
choice_data_list: Then do you think you can 'hold back'?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she runs through the pain, it'll only
limit her
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if I take that choice away from her,
deprive
her of even the possibility, then
it'll be her heart
that breaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, she'll need to take
better care
of her nails than she has
been. I'll also look into
getting special
shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to make her feet our first
priority... Then
we can continue training
to win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: You won't have any time left to play.
You won't have any time left to play.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Are you prepared to stake everything on the race?
Are you prepared to stake everything on the race?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Of course I am.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it big! I want to race, no
matter
what!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: If it hurts next time, please tell me right away.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sorry for keeping quiet about it before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: Is she okay?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's a relief. Still, if her injury is
as
serious as it seems, does that mean
the Satsuki
Sho is out of the qu—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask the reporter not to write about
what
happened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that we don't want any strange
rumors
going around ahead of the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... you're going to force
her to run
while she's injured?

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
I... can't agree to that. I'm a journalist. If
you
really intend to push your trainee
to—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No! That's not what's happening! We're
going to
make sure my nails are fully
healed!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So... please! I'm begging you! Please
help us out...
For my Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. I'll keep it to myself for now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin our days taking care of
Tosen
Jordan's feet while preparing for
the Satsuki Sho.
